description: Nearby mobs, players, dropped items and points of interest (containers, workstations, beds, portals), and optionally blocks you name, described relative to where you look: "zombie: 5 ahead, 2 right · 5.4 m (1 o'clock)". Easier to act on than world coordinates; each line still ends with the coordinates for tools that need them. Client side, works in multiplayer; needs enableVision.

find.description: Block ids to locate as well, e.g. ["oak_log","iron_ore"].

name: surroundings
title: What is around me, relative to my view
